title: Usage Insights (In-console) — Beta Customer Candidate List
content:
Last updated: 2026-02-20 (Paula)

Purpose
- Identify a small, high-signal set of beta accounts for “In-console usage insights” (route + model cost breakdown, top cost drivers, export, RBAC).
- Balance: (a) strong demand + weekly feedback loop, (b) coverage across deployment modes, (c) manageable risk on billing correctness.

Beta mechanics (working)
- Feature flag: console.usage_insights_beta
- Enablement: allowlist by workspace_id (Support/Internal request via INT-9132), plus workspace setting “Cost visibility: admins only / finance+admins / everyone”.
- Export: CSV export behind permission “cost:export” (logs required). Target: 10–15 design partners; 5–8 active weekly.

Legend
- Deployment: Hosted | Dedicated | Private (VPC) | Private (On-prem)
- Risk flags (common):
  - Strict billing reconciliation (invoice comparisons, low tolerance)
  - Private deployment / data residency constraints
  - High cardinality routes (dynamic paths, untemplated endpoints)
  - OpenAI-compat endpoints heavy usage (route normalization sensitivity)
  - Long time ranges (30d queries) / performance risk
  - Model alias churn (potential duplicate rows)

Columns
Account | Segment | Deployment | Primary region(s) | Est. monthly spend | Why good beta | Risk flags | Must-have for success | Outreach owner | Current status | Next step / notes

Candidate list (sorted by expected signal)
AcmeAI | Enterprise eval | Dedicated | us-east-1 | $45k–$70k | Explicit request for cost by route+model + weekly “what changed”; finance needs CSV | Strict billing reconciliation; wants totals to match invoice; OpenAI-compat endpoints | Route+model rollup; CSV export; shareable report link (optional) | Markus Klein | Intro sent (2026-01-12), technical deep dive done | Confirm allowlist + security posture; schedule weekly check-in; success metric: matches invoice within tolerance
Northstar Fintech | Enterprise | Private (VPC) | us-east-1, eu-west-1 | $80k–$120k | High-value compliance use case; strong RBAC + audit logging requirements; would validate permissions model | Private/VPC; strict audit logging; data residency constraints; legal review likely | RBAC (hide cost); audit logs for export/download; billing reconciliation | Evan Scott | Demo done (2026-01-21) | Provide written beta limitations; get approvals from security contact; enable once audit log fields finalized
Heliochat | Mid-market customer | Hosted + Dedicated burst | us-west-2 | $25k–$40k | Existing customer expanding; wants internal chargeback by route; engaged CSM/QBR cadence | Model mix shifts frequently; long-context workloads (latency spend sensitivity) | Top cost drivers + “what changed”; route normalization stable; cache hit/miss | Markus Klein | Active: agreed to beta | Enable flag; set baseline week; ask them to validate driver explanations vs their own tracking

Second-wave / coverage accounts
DocuSynth | Mid-market | Hosted | us-east-1 | $12k–$18k | Very API-route heavy (multiple microservices); will stress route normalization + cardinality | High cardinality routes (some untemplated); risk of “other/unknown” bucket too large | Route normalization + guardrails; drilldown UX | Evan Scott | Not contacted | Ask for sample endpoint list; ensure they accept grouping rules; enable if route templating coverage is good
QuantaSearch | Growth startup | Hosted | eu-west-1 | $8k–$15k | Strong embeddings + rerank usage; helps ensure non-chat routes show up correctly | Mixed endpoints; expects export to BI | Export format stability; correct totals vs billing | Markus Klein | Warm intro pending | Pair with Rishi for finance workflow validation (CSV -> BI)
LedgerLoop | Enterprise | Dedicated | us-east-1 | $60k–$90k | FinOps team already tracks tokens; wants “driver” visibility (retries, fallbacks) | Strict billing comparisons; sensitive to retry definitions | Retry/fallback attribution semantics; documentation/tooltips | Markus Klein | Not contacted | Align on definitions (“what counts as a retry”); provide beta glossary upfront
MedAtlas | Enterprise | Private (VPC) | eu-central-1 | $30k–$55k | Regulated workload; validates retention + export controls | Private/VPC; data residency; export restrictions | Retention alignment + export controls + audit logs | Evan Scott | In discovery | Confirm whether exports allowed; if not, still valuable for in-console views + RBAC
SparrowCRM | Mid-market | Hosted | us-west-2 | $6k–$10k | Lots of streaming; will validate streaming overhead metrics | Streaming route tags missing historically in one region (known issue class) | Streaming overhead + accurate tokens out | Dev Patel | Support escalations prior | Only enable after route tags verified for streaming endpoints; use as validation for instrumentation
BuildBot | Startup | Hosted | us-east-1 | $3k–$6k | Very engaged dev team; fast feedback on UX copy/tooltips | Low spend (lower priority); may churn quickly | “Top drivers” explainability; docs links | Alex Martinez | Not contacted | Use as DX feedback partner; ok to include if we need more UX signal

Billing correctness / reconciliation stress tests (opt-in)
QuantGrid | Enterprise | Hosted | us-east-1 | $20k–$35k | Finance team compares to invoice weekly; strong reconciliation feedback | Strict billing reconciliation; low tolerance; expects zero drift | Totals match billing hooks; time zone handling | Rishi Malhotra | Not contacted | Only after ENG-3817 reconciliation suite is green; set expectation on tolerances and data freshness
Aperture Labs | Enterprise | Dedicated | us-east-1 | $40k–$65k | Heavy use of fallbacks/rollouts; validates attribution across model variants | Model alias/version churn; fallback attribution complexity | Model family/version bucketing; fallback cost attribution | Marissa Cole | Not contacted | Coordinate with rollouts team; ensure explainability strings don’t mislead

Private / higher compliance (only if ready)
RedCedar GovTech | Enterprise | Private (On-prem) | on-prem | $50k–$90k | Important for roadmap, but beta risk high | On-prem; air-gapped constraints; export restrictions; slower feedback loop | N/A for initial beta unless deployment supports telemetry | Connor O'Brien | Parked | Out of initial beta scope unless we have a clean telemetry path; keep warm for follow-up
VantaBank | Enterprise | Private (VPC) | eu-west-1 | $70k–$110k | Strong RBAC/audit needs; validates enterprise messaging | Private/VPC; strict audit logging; legal review | RBAC + audit; shareable links (read-only) requested | Markus Klein | Not contacted | Check if they require PDF (out of scope); if yes, set expectation early

Known-risk accounts (enable only after specific fixes)
OpenAICompat Power User (StealthCo) | Growth startup | Hosted | us-east-1 | $10k–$22k | Would validate OpenAI-compat route mapping | OpenAI-compat route normalization gaps (see SUP-24827 class) | Correct route breakdown for compat endpoints | Dev Patel | Support contact exists | Gate on route normalization mapping being confirmed in their region; otherwise will generate noise
AliasHeavy Inc. | Mid-market | Hosted | us-west-2 | $9k–$14k | Model alias churn validates bucketing | Risk of duplicate rows (SUP-24844 class) | Model family/version bucketing | Chloe Martin | Not contacted | Only after model alias dedupe is stable; otherwise defer
LongRange Analytics | Enterprise | Hosted | us-east-1 | $15k–$30k | Validates 30-day range performance | 30-day query timeouts (SUP-24863 class) | 30d range usable (or clear guidance/limits) | Dylan Brooks | Not contacted | Enable only after query optimizations and/or enforced range limits + messaging

Proposed beta cohort (v1)
- Enable first: Heliochat, AcmeAI, Northstar Fintech (if audit log fields ready), DocuSynth
- Add next (coverage): QuantaSearch, LedgerLoop, MedAtlas
- Keep as “correctness stress”: QuantGrid (only once reconciliation is solid)

Approvals / readiness checklist (before enabling an account)
- [ ] Feature flag allowlist updated + internal ticket logged (INT-9132)
- [ ] Workspace role mapping confirmed (who should see cost)
- [ ] Export permissions confirmed + audit logging enabled
- [ ] Customer aware of beta limitations: data freshness lag, grouping rules, rounding tolerance
- [ ] Named weekly feedback owner (customer) + Redwood POC (SE/PM)

Notes / open questions
- Need final statement on reconciliation tolerance and how we message it (Finance + Billing hooks: Rishi + Cole).
- For “shareable reports”: current plan is link sharing with RBAC; PDF export is out of scope for beta.
- Confirm whether we enforce max time range for interactive queries (e.g., 7d default, 30d allowed but slower) and how we message in-console.
